title: Closure under polynomial-time reductions
statement: Let $L$ and $L'$ be languages of bit strings. If $L'$ is polynomial-time many-one reducible to $L$ and $L$ belongs to the bounded-error class defined by the specified polynomial-time verifier model, then $L'$ belongs to that class as well.
hypotheses_covered: A polynomial-time many-one reduction from $L'$ to $L$
Membership of $L$ in the bounded-error class for the specified polynomial-time verifier model
